title: Spot Delivery and Dealer Rate Markup Schedule — Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
**F&I schedule, Vehicle Purchase Agreements.** This schedule sets, by deal type, whether spot delivery is offered, the lender approval window on a spot delivery, whether miles driven on a failed spot delivery may be charged, and the cap on the dealer's APR markup over the lender's buy rate.

| Deal type | Spot delivery offered | Lender approval window (calendar days after the delivery date) | Miles driven during a failed spot delivery may be charged | Markup cap (APR percentage points over the buy rate) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Value Line Used Vehicle Purchase | no | 0 | no | 2.5 |
| Used Vehicle Retail Purchase | yes | 10 | no | 2.5 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Purchase | yes | 10 | no | 2.0 |
| New Vehicle Retail Purchase | yes | 10 | no | 2.0 |
| New Vehicle Factory Order Purchase | yes | 10 | no | 2.0 |
| Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement | no | 0 | no | 0.0 |

Hypothetical: on a Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Purchase with a lender buy rate of 6.15 percent APR, the contract APR may be no more than 8.15 percent, which is the buy rate plus 2.0 points.
